description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'AbstractCommandSizeValidator' responsible for validating size constraints on commands within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes methods to enforce size limits and generate exceptions when limits are exceeded.

classes.name: AbstractCommandSizeValidator
classes.description: An abstract class for validating command sizes, parameterized by a specific exception type T.

methods.name: getMaxSize
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the maximum allowed size, if set.

methods.name: ensureValidSize
methods.description: Checks if the size exceeds the maximum limit and throws an exception if it does.

methods.name: ensureValidSize (overloaded)
methods.description: Checks size against an upper bound and maximum size, calling the other ensureValidSize method if conditions are met.

methods.name: newInvalidSizeException
methods.description: Abstract method to create a new exception when size validation fails.
